tutorial.welcome: A quick tour. Skip leaves it at any point.
tutorial.credits: Credits: the licence and the project's links.
tutorial.edit_profile: Edit Profile sets the name you join with.
tutorial.accounts: Add an account, then Select it to play as it.
tutorial.version: Picking a version here forces it. Left alone, the client matches each server.
tutorial.video: Video Settings: render distance, GUI scale, brightness.
tutorial.shader_button: Shaders: open Shader Packs at the bottom of Video Settings.
tutorial.shader_folder: Put a shader pack zip in this folder, or drop it on the window. R reads the folder again.
tutorial.shader_folder_android: Put a shader pack zip in this folder. R reads the folder again.
tutorial.shader_list: Tap a pack to turn it on. (none) turns shaders off.
tutorial.editor_areas: The HUD editor. Areas are touch zones.
tutorial.look_area: Look area: only turns the camera.
tutorial.zoom_area: Zoom: double tap and hold. Triple tap locks it.
tutorial.elsewhere: Elsewhere: tap attacks, hold mines, double tap places.
tutorial.new_area: Adds an area. Drag to move, drag an edge to resize.
tutorial.editor_controls: Touch buttons. Drag to move, pinch to resize.
tutorial.chat_button: Chat. Its SWAP button turns chat portrait.
tutorial.swap: SWAP: chat like a messaging app. Tap again to go back.
tutorial.editor_extras: The HUD itself: hotbar, chat, coordinates.
tutorial.touch_layout: Controls, then Edit control layout, changes the touch controls.
tutorial.touch_movement: Tap Movement until it reads Bedrock D-Pad or Bedrock Joystick for Bedrock Edition's controls.
tutorial.bedrock_look: The Bedrock controls, in Mojang's art. Your own controls come back after this step.
